notes.title: Volantia - Patch 1.41
notes.notes:
18/02/2018

Added new hotkeys:

    F - fullscreen / windowed
    WASD - move camera
    Z - open island menu
    X - open production menu
    C - open housing menu
    V - open service menu
    B - open science menu
    N - build road tool
    T - open tech tree


Added new text:

    tutorial now talks about camera controls
    tutorial now talks about rotating islands
    extra help screen with basic controls


Gameplay changes:

    Zardim now act like they do in sandbox mode, once the kingdom is stabilised
